fact: The ADM-Kenya project (21 November 2022 to 20 November 2024) built Sentinel-based crop condition, drought hazard and irrigated/rainfed maps with the Ministry of Agriculture, which plans to incorporate them into its monthly Food Security and Agricultural Status Bulletin.
title: Integrated use of multisource remote sensing data for national scale agricultural drought monitoring in Kenya (ADM-Kenya final report)
publisher: ADM-Kenya / ESA EO Africa (ZALF, icipe, RCMRD, Ministry of Agriculture)
